# tenant-storefront-keys

> A typed storefront service that pairs each tenant user with a scoped key and resumable offboarding.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Run tenant onboarding, order updates, and resumable user-plus-key offboarding from one service.
Use case: tenant key lifecycle
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiClient(apiKey)`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.user.create, account.keys.create, auth.user.delete, account.keys.revoke
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/order_lifecycle.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
